recommendation: Keep the core audit commit as-is. Treat the Extension Pack operationoutcome-instance-id StructureDefinition as the applied artifact for FHIR-45310; any future metadata cleanup or changes for that extension should be handled in HL7/fhir-extensions.
issue_request: FHIR-45310 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification. The tracker asked how an OperationOutcome recipient could receive an identifier for support and audit-log lookup, considering X-Request-Id/X-Correlation-Id narrative or an OperationOutcome.issue identifier. The final resolution rejected X-Request-Id as inappropriate outside request/response situations and requested a new 0..1 string extension on OperationOutcome.issue.
initial_application: No core FHIR source commit mentioning FHIR-45310 was found. HL7/fhir-extensions commit 0e90d0ca3705df6f6fc10264e69e511200f7b3d4 adds StructureDefinition-operationoutcome-instance-id.xml with the requested OperationOutcome.issue context, string value, max 1, and Jira wording.
additional_context: The originating Zulip discussion supports a distinct issue-occurrence identifier and rejects reusing OperationOutcome.id or operationoutcome-message-id. FHIR-I minutes on 2024-04-29 record that X-Request-Id did not fit; minutes on 2024-05-06 record agreement to add instanceId as a single-valued extension. The current core OperationOutcome page links extensions to the FHIR Extension Pack, where the extension is present in the CI build.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined core branch. No core source change was made because the approved artifact belongs to HL7/fhir-extensions and is already present there; adding duplicate core extension source or rejected header guidance would be incorrect.
